page: OVHcloud a10-45 is a GPU-accelerated server powered by an AMD EPYC 9554 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 30 dedicated physical cores running at 3.3 GHz with one thread per core, paired with 42.0 GB of system memory. The server includes a bundled NVIDIA A10 GPU from the Ampere architecture with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM, alongside 400 GB of local SSD storage and an 8 Gbps baseline network interface.

Benchmark results indicate strong compute performance, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core metrics placing in the top 25%. The CPU's support for advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and cryptography extensions like AES and SHA_NI, drives high efficiency in specialized tasks. This is reflected in strong Passmark CPU encryption and extended instruction scores. While small-block cached memory read bandwidth is strong, large-block uncached read and write operations perform in the average range.

This configuration offers a cost-effective entry point for GPU-accelerated computing, balancing dedicated AMD EPYC CPU resources with a professional-grade NVIDIA A10 GPU. The hardware profile is optimized for workloads such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, 3D rendering, database operations, and parallel software compilation.
